tei:div.tei:p: (389)byang gter tshe bdag gtor ma'i bca' thabs bzhugs so// (390)

gnas pa'i 'khor lo ngo bo nyid kyi gzhir// srid pa'i 'khor lo 'khrul pas brtags pa rnams// 'dul byed sprul pa'i 'khor lo bsgrub pa las// gcod pa'i 'khor lo'i phyag rgyar lhun gyis grub/ tshe bdag gtor ma bca' thabs ni/ zhal zas ni rting pa sder ba tshul khrims bslab pa/ lto ba ldir ba ting nge 'dzin/ rtse mo rno ba shes rab mtshon byed/ mdog dkar po gnyis rgyan la/ lte ba zai'u 'bru dmar po bsgril ba re/ sa lha dkar gtor/ pad 'dab bzhi/ mdun pad g.yas g.yon bha ling ril bu gnyis rgyan ze'u 'bru bcas/ zhi ba'i rigs la pad 'dab med pas bha ling ril bu gcig sbyar/ bgegs gtor mdzub gang ma/ mdun du mar me dang*/ rgyab tu lan chags kyis dkris pa/ mar me la mtheb skyu sbyar ba can dmar po gnyis rgyan ze'u 'bru can/ rgyal chen 'bul gtor ri rab bang rim bzhi yi steng du/ zur bzhi dkar gtor mdzub gang ba re bar du ril bu bzhi gnyis rgyan ze'u dmar bcas/ tshogs mchod bza' btung bcas/ yi dam thugs sgrub las bzhi lhun grub gtor ma 'di rtse la dkar rgyan/ dpung pa gnyis la dkar rgyan/ zan kong steng du ril bu bzhi/ dkar rgyan gyi nang gzhi dmar skya/ nang dmar chen/ ze'u 'bru dkar po/ brang rgyan lnga bskor chung la/ gzhi sngo skya nang sngo chen (391) ze'u 'bru mtshal/ mtha' bskor dung phreng gzhi dkar po/ mtshal chen gyi ril bu re/ g.yas g.yon mar skud/ gtor ma'i stod khog dmar po/ nang ma'i gru bzhir/ gzhi dmar skya/ nang dmar chen/ bcad mar skud/ steng phra ba la dmar chen/ mtha' mar skud/ rgyab zur gsum mar skud/ rgyab g.yas g.yon gnyis la gri ris ltar mar skud/ rtse yi mtha' bskor mar skud/ rtse khra 'dzugs pa'i dbang du byas na/ brang rgyan ma gtogs dpung rgyan dang rtse rgyan mi dgos/ dpe khra la mtha' me ris dang*/ so li khri/ de'i pa tra yang li khri/ pa tra thams cad khug lnga pa/

g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi me ris ljang gu/ pa tra'ang ljang gu/ g.yas g.yon me ris mtshal chen/ pa tra'ang mtshal chen/ yang g.yas g.yon me ris ser po pa tra yang ser chen/ mtha'i g.yas g.yon me ri sngon po/ pa tra yang sngo chen/ kha skud rnams li khri'i steng du ljang gu/ ljang gu'i steng du mtshal chen/ mtshal chen steng du ljang gu/ ser po'i steng du mtshal chen/ sngon po'i steng du dkar po/ shing lo gsum lo/ shing lo dang pa tra'i bar bcad/ dang po dkar/ gnyis pa dmar/ gsum pa mthing ka'o// padma'i sdong po bdun/ me tog (392) khyi sna/ dbus su rdo rje mthing ga rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ yig mthing gas mtshan pa/ bcad dkar po/ g.yas g.yon gyi phrag rgyan gnyis la/ dang po pa tra me ris bcas pa li khri/ gnyis pa pa tra me ris bcas pa ljang gu/ gsum pa pa tra me ris bcas pa dmar chen/ kha skud la li khri steng du ljang gu/ ljang gu'i steng du mtshal chen/ dmar chen steng du ljang gu/ pa tra dang mtha' gnyis bar rgya nag lcags ri/ gzhi nag po la/ lcags ri dkar po khugs ma/ mtha' bcad dmar po bcas/ bka' brgyad dang thugs sgrub gnyis rtse bkra 'dra/ smad gru bzhi zheng che chen re/ srid du cha chen re/ phyogs bzhi la pad 'dab bzhi/ phyi ljang gu/ nang dmar chen/ rtse la padma 'dab bzhi/ sked par pad 'dab bzhi/ padma la khog dkar po/ dmangs dmar po/ mar skud dkar pau/ ze'u 'bru mthing chen/ phyi mtha' thams cad mar skud/ g.yas g.yon gnyis phyi sngo skya/ nang sngo chen/ rgyab gong ma dang 'dra/ mar skud dang me tog yang gzhan gsum po gong dang 'dra/ g.yas g.yon zan kong rnams la/ gzhi dmar po/ zan kong nang mar gyi ril bu re/ kha (393) skud steng zhabs gnyis bar du dung phreng dkar po/ bka' brgyad dang mkha' 'gro thugs sgrub gsum ka/ smad gru bzhi/ kha skud me tog rnams 'dra'o/ bka' brgyad la nyi zla/ thugs sgrub la zla gdan rkyang pa/ mkha' 'gro la nyi gdan rkyang pa/

bla ma la zla gdan rkyang pa/ bla ma'i padma rnams mdzes mtshon/ me tog dang mar skud sngar dang 'dra/ nyi ma dmar po/ kha skud ser po/ zla ba dkar po/ kha skud dkar po/ byang gter bka' brgyad gter ma/ 'di'i sman gtor bya/ rtse la dkar rgyan/ dpung rgyan gnyis/ rtse la phyi dmar chen/ nang mthing ka ze'u 'bru dkar po/ g.yas g.yon gnyis phyi ljang gu/ nang ljang chen/ ze'u 'bru dkar po/ dung phreng gzhi nag po/ dung phreng dkar po/ ril bu mthing ga g.yas g.yon mar skud/ gtor ma'i khog dmar po/ gru bzhi gzhi sngo skya/ nang sngo chen/ bcad dmar chen/ padma la dkar rgyan pad 'dab bzhi bskor thugs sgrub dang 'dra/ mar skud dmar po/ rgyab dang smad thugs sgrub dang 'dra/ rtse khra btsugs na thugs sgrub rtse bkra dang 'gros gcig pas me tog brgyad la bka' brgyad rang rang phyag mtshan rang rang sa bon hūm̐ yig mthing gas mtshan pa/ bcad dang shing lo thams cad thugs sgrub dang 'dra/ (394) rtse la me tog kha 'bus la khad pa che chung gnyis/ mkha' 'gro la gtor ma'i khog dmar po/ dbus gru bzhi phyi ljang gu/ nang ljang chen/ bcad mtshal chen/ kha skud dkar po/ dung phreng bka' brgyad dang mtshungs/ dkar rgyan dang gzhung rnams bka' brgyad dang 'dra/ rgyab yang bka' brgyad dang 'dra/ rtse bkra khog thugs sgrub dang 'dra ba la nang me tog lnga/ me tog dbus ma'i lte bar mkha' 'gro'i phyag mtshan gri gug dang*/ thod khrag gri gug gi lte bar srog yig baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ bla ma la/ stod khog dmar po/ rtsai mo gzhi ljang gu la/ dmar chen gyis pa tra khug lnga pa bri/ rtse rgyan dpung rgyan gnyis/ phyi dmar skya/ nang dmar chen/ ze'u 'bru dkar po/ gsum ka 'dra/ brang rgyan thugs sgrub dang 'dra/ rtse bkra la/ pa tra khug drug la dang po dmar chen/ kha skud ljang gu/ gnyis pa g.yas g.yon ser po/ kha skud ljang gu/ gsum pa mtshal chen/ kha skud ljang gu/ bzhi pa ljang gu/ kha skud mtshal chen/

lnga pa g.yas g.yon mthing*/ kha skud dkar po dbus kyi lte ba'i bcad dang po dkar po/ gnyis pa ser po/ gsum pa dmar po'o// dbus kyi lo ma 'dab drug sdong po lnga la/ utpala'i me tog (395) 'dab drug can lnga/ dbus kyi lte ba la/ rdo rje ser po rtse lnga pa/ lte bar hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ g.yas g.yon phrag rgyan/ dang po dmar po/ kha skud ljang gu/ gnyis pa ljang gu/ kha skud mtshal chen/ gsum pa ser po/ kha skud dmar chen/ bzhi pa mthing ga kha skud dkar po/ lcags mkhar la/ khog nag po lcags mdog rtse'i nag po'i nang ma dmar chen/ de'i nang ma ljang gu/ mtha' nas gri ris ltar mar skud/ phyi ma dung phreng gzhi dkar po/ ze'u 'bru dmar chen/ nang ma ze'u 'bru mthing ga gdan gru gsum steng ma'i thog la'ang*/ gtor ma'i mdun gyi ri mo thams cad dod par bya/ steng gi rtse la nor bus brgyan pa/ g.yas g.yon dpung rgyan/ phyi dmar skya/ nang dmar chen/ ze'u 'bru dkar po/ nor bu mthing skya la/ nang mthing chen/ rtse dkar po/ mtha' me ri dmar chen/ 'og pad 'dab gsum pa/ rtse khra btsugs na phrag rgyan gnyis mi dgos/ gtor ma'i rgyab kyi gdong nas mar skud shar gcig lcags mkhar gdong nas g.yas g.yon mar skud/ steng zhabs gnyis la dung phreng ltar mar skud gong 'og gnyis re/ gdong la thod skam (396) gsum re/ khog dkar po/ ri mo dmar po/ dung phreng tshab thod skam re de ltar ro/ lcags mkhar 'og la de ltar rtsab chung rnams la'ang thod rwa steng 'og gnyis re thams cad la dgos/ mdun g.yas g.yon gru gsum zur gsum la sprul pa gsum mtshon byed mar gyi thod skam mdzes tshon gsum/ 'og ma'i rtsibs mchan drug rtsa ba'i lha drug mtshon pa'i dmar gtor rang 'dra drug rtse khram la me ri pa tra thugs sgrub dang 'dra ba la/ nang du padma 'dab brgyad kyi rgyan par lha brgyad kyi sa bon nam gzugs gang rung*/ dbus kyi padma la lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa sngon po dbus su e yig gis mtshan pa/

rtsibs mchan drug la yig mgo nang bstan gyis/ ya ma/ snying khrag ra ma/ tsa ya/ bkod pa'am med kyang rung*/ phrag rgyan gnyis sngar dang 'dra ba la rgya nag lcags ri'i tshab tu nas 'bru bzhi bskor bya/ lcags mkhar gzhan la/ gru gsum nang du nya bo mgo mthur bstan pa/ mar skud/ rtse rgya ra sogs snga ma dang 'dra/ phur pa 'di la 'khor bzhi rang 'dra la mdun du mtheb skyu bzhis rgyan pa khra thabs nyer gcig mchan bzhi ra dam gtor bzhi/ bar mtshams thams cad theb kyu ril bu gsum re/ rtse la (397) dkar rgyan/ dpung pa gnyis la mi dgos so/ mtshams kyis dmar gtor mdun la ba ling gsum re phur srung bcu gnyis/ de steng ril bu re res bskor ba bzhi mtshan byed dam/ khog thams cad dmar po/ brang rgyan sum mtshams/ rtse la dkar rgyan re/ gtso khog dmar po/ mtha' dung phreng*/ nang gru bzhi thams cad thugs sgrub dang 'dra/ dkar rgyan nang dmar skya/ gzhi dmar chen/ ze'u 'bru dkar po/ rtse phra thugs sgrub dang 'dra/ bzlog gtor dpe ris ltar la/ mthar dung phreng gzhi nag la dkar po/ spyan gsum/ gra zur thams cad dmar skya/ nang dmar nag gzhung dkar po/ de nang nag po/ yang ser po/ de'i steng du nag po'i thig le gcig shangs mtha' dmar po/ nang dmar nag kha sha mtha' dmar skya/ nang dmar nag ljags phyi dmar skya/ g.yas su dkyus pa/ nang dmar nag kha g.yas g.yon du/ mi ro dang rta ro 'phyangs pa/ mche ba bzhi zla tshes rgyas pa dum bu phyed pa lta bu/ sma ra smin ma thams cad me ri sum dkyus ma/ gzhi ser po la/ rag 'dur dang khyim phyi gang rung gi ser chen/ mar skud dkar po/ spyan dang shangs ljags kyi mtha' thams cad skud dkar po/ gtor ma'i gzhi dmar skya la mdangs dmar nag rtse phra la me ri sum khug ma pa tra mgo drug pa tra dang po dmar/ (398) kha skud ljang*/ gnyis pa g.yas g.yon ser/ kha skud dmar chen/ gsum pa g.yas g.yon ljang*/ kha skud dmar skya/ bzhi pa g.yas g.yon nag

kha skud dkar/ lnga pa g.yas g.yon mtshal/ kha skud ljang gu'o// nang gi bcad gsum dmar/ dkar/ ljang gsum/ nang me ri rgyu zhags la nang che mchog gi phyag mtshan tshang ma g.yas g.yon phyag rgyar/ dang po gsum dmar/ kha skud ljang*/ gnyis pa gnyis ser/ kha skud dmar chen/ gsum pa gnyis nag kha skud dmar skya/ bzhi pa mthing*/ kha skud dkar po'am/ zan chad rgyab nas rtse bar slan/ dbang po'i me tog gzhi zan gor cha phran gyis 'thug pa/ gzhi nag po la/ steng zhabs dmar skud dkar po/ thod skam gyi dung phreng*/ dmar pos mdangs/ thod skam gzhi dkar po/ kha sha rnams dmar skya/ mig khung nag po/ so bar dmar skya/ so dkar/ lce gzhi dmar skya/ nang dmar chen mdangs/ shangs dmar nag snying dmar nag rna ba gnyis gzhi dkar po/ ze ba dmar chen gyis mar skud 'then/ rna ba'i mtha' mar skud dmar po/ mig 'bras rna ba'i steng du bkug pa la mig 'bras gzhi dkar po/ thig nag po/ ser po'i ze'u 'bru/ rtse la dug gi me tog 'dab ma brgyad pa phyi sngo skya/ (399) nang sngo chen/ ze'u 'bru dmar po/ sha rus zhal zas mtha' thams cad dmar po'i me ri sum khug ma tong skud kyi bris pa/ khog dmar po/ nang dmar nag gri ris ltar mar skud 'then/ gzhi gru gsum nag po la/ dung phreng dkar po steng 'og gnyis/ bar du thod rlon gyi dung phreng mdzes tshon no// chad tho dmar/ rtse me ris rgyan/ mtshe yung rtsang gsum sha khrag gis rgyan/ brtan ma la/ dbus su lha zlum dkar/ g.yas su bdud smad gru bzhi stod zlum po nag po/ g.yon du btsan dmar gtor zur gsum/ smad dkris dmar/ dung phreng dang mar skud 'then/ sngon du ba ling g.yas g.yon gsum re drug rgyab tu g.yas g.yon gsum re drug gnyis rgyan mdzes tshon no/// /
